name: Begraense
description: The fortified capital of Ben’net stands at the foot of towering glaciers, its icy walls protecting its northern flank, while the Frostflow River’s cold, turbulent waters cover its eastern side. The city rises on several concentric plateaus, each encircled by walls that limit access to unauthorized persons. Here, the Ironhand’s vigilance is strict, yielding an impeccable organization and negligible crime. The densest population resides in the lower tiers, marked by inns and stables. Ascending zones, one can find merchant shops, temples, and garrisons, culminating in the central Nobles’ Ward, where one can find Governor Bonas Weyrdo’s palace. Beneath the city lie concealed passages and subterranean chambers, facilitating the swift deployment of Ironhand troops and housing prisons and hidden halls. This network allows soldiers to appear abruptly when trouble arises, with entry points scattered throughout the city. Begraense allows cirrus and envoys from other factions, like the Allied Forces and the Arcanum, to enter but keeps them under close surveillance. Despite the stringent regulations of the city, an underground black market thrives, trading in Highlandtuber Distillate, magic items, and other prohibited goods. It is controlled by a figure known as “The Veiled Baron,” who allegedly has ties to the Imperial echelons and the Bloodbound Mafia. This hub offers rare goods and information, and its existence under Governor Bonas’ jurisdiction is rumored to have resulted from a deal with the Baron. Adventurers and mercenaries can often find work here, from commoners seeking aid they cannot find with the Ironhand, such as to find disappeared family members, to members of the Third Eye seeking individuals to perform dangerous tasks, to hidden rebels trying to incite the populace against the Empire by seeking help to expose the misdeeds of Governor Bonnas. Many more factions are seeking capable hands than those willing to venture into this harsh, cold north, so plenty of tasks are available.
